description: Sets one field worker's availability for a date, or a date range (end_date, up to 92 days): a day off (day_off: true), one shift (available_from + available_until, HH:MM), or split shifts (windows). It replaces that day's override; hours equal to the weekly default clear it. Nothing is sent to anyone. Returns the override ids and any booking conflicts the change creates, for a person to resolve. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the original override ids.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: set_staff_availability
title: Set a field worker's availability for a date
